articles.title: US regulators to weigh controversial peptides backed by RFK Jr
articles.description: FDA has questioned the evidence as demand surges for the compounds promoted for sleep, muscle growth, and anti-ageing.

articles.title: Global oil prices settle at 6-week high after topping $95 a barrel, as hopes dim for de-escalation of Iran war
articles.description: Oil prices settled at six-week highs on Wednesday after the U.S. struck Iran for the 11th night in a row and President Donald Trump warned that the U.S. will bomb Iranian bridges and power plants if Tehran fires on ships in the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: ‘Owning a pet has become a luxury’ — vets worry about higher prices and shrinking pet population, survey finds
articles.description: A Morgan Stanley survey shows that U.S. vet practices are growing sales by raising prices as they contend with fewer visits —a formula that analysts say is unsustainable.

articles.title: Analysis: Iran war energy shock hits the U.S. economy as gas and diesel prices climb
articles.description: A new asymmetry in the market means fuel prices won't fall quickly even if the shooting in the Iran war and Strait of Hormuz stops.

articles.title: Trump threatens to target Iran's bridges and power plants if Hormuz attacks persist
articles.description: Donald Trump says the US will respond any time Iranian forces shoot at a ship in the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Watch: Louvre reopens gallery after jewellery heist
articles.description: The Louvre Museum reopens its Apollo Gallery nine months after a robbery that shocked France.

articles.title: Why Iran is risking so much over the Strait of Hormuz
articles.description: None of the choices facing Iran’s leaders offer a clear path to victory, as the conflict with the US continues.
